name: UVA Advance Pre-College Program
org: University of Virginia Summer and Special Academic Programs
what_you_do: A four-week residential program on UVA's campus where rising juniors and seniors take one core class and one elective for letter grades and six transferable credits, plus college readiness workshops.
who_can_apply: Rising high school juniors and seniors in good standing with a minimum 3.5 GPA in a college prep curriculum, age 15 or older on the first day and 18 or younger on the last day.
pay_detail: The FAQ says the maximum aid package covers full tuition and fees for Virginia residents, which is $7,097 for 2026. The cost for other students and the full breakdown were not read. Small number of need-based aid packages.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: application opened December 1; deadline March 1, 2026; teacher recommendation March 4; decisions March 31; accept by April 15. No 2027 dates posted yet.
how_to_apply: Online application with transcripts, one teacher or administrator recommendation uploaded by the recommender, and a 350 to 500 word essay. Financial aid materials are due by March 1.
notes: Residents live in an air-conditioned residence hall with a 10 pm curfew. Travel, books, laundry and spending money are not included. Questions: UVaAdvance@virginia.edu, 434-243-2241. The Cost and Payment page was not read.
